description: What a user said about one agent reply. Its own record rather than a key in Chat Message.metadata, because the question this data exists to answer — every negative rating for one agent over a date range — is a query, and metadata is an unindexed Code blob.

fields.description: Why. Chips the user clicked; empty is normal — a single click is a complete rating.
fields.label: Reasons

fields.description: Optional free text. Screened for PII and prompt injection on the way in, like any other user-entered chat text.
fields.label: Comment

fields.description: Triage state. An eval case is only ever created from Reviewed feedback — every thumbs-down is not a regression. Fixed is set once the Process Owner has corrected the underlying issue.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The preceding user turn's text — the question this reply answered, if any. A snapshot so a reviewer sees both sides without following links.
fields.label: User Message

fields.description: The AI reply's own text at rating time — a snapshot, so it survives later edits or trimming of the Chat Message it was read from.
fields.label: Output

fields.description: The run that produced the reply — this is the join to cost, latency and the trace.
fields.label: Agent Run

fields.description: The regression test this complaint became, if any.
fields.label: Eval Case

fields.description: message|user. Unique, so one person cannot hold two ratings on one reply — re-rating updates in place.
fields.label: Dedup Key

fields.description: Who this was assigned to for review — the AI Response Feedback Handling process resolves this from the reply's AI Agent Configuration and writes it here; not editable directly.
fields.label: Process Owner

fields.description: When the Process Owner marked the underlying issue fixed. Set by the same process, alongside status becoming Fixed.
fields.label: Fixed On

name: AI Response Feedback
